name: logistics-fleet-tracking
description: Real-Time Logistics & Fleet Tracking System - root launcher for the server and client

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n server,client,sim -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run simulate:wait --prefix . "
scripts.simulate:wait: wait-on tcp:5000 && npm run simulate --prefix server -- --auto
scripts.serve: npm run build && cross-env SERVE_CLIENT=true npm start --prefix server
